subtitle: Temporary sandbox credentials for coding agents.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: I want agents to run AWS experiments while I'm away from my laptop.

sections.heading: Mechanism
sections.body: A phone app toggles the credential Lambda used by the remote sandbox.

sections.heading: Access window
sections.body: Turn access on, let the agent run, then turn access off again.

sections.heading: Same pattern
sections.body: Temporary, revocable AWS access without long-lived keys on the machine.
